entities.summary: Hildá Birget Länsman, also known by her Sámi name Ánn-Ovllá Káre Jari Hildá, is a Sámi singer-songwriter and musician. She is a vocalist and yoikist in the bands Vildá, Solju, and Gájanas. In 2025, Länsman made her solo debut with the album Dajan.
